remaining_limits: SO-101 still has wrong-direction learned requests and joint-limit stalls; isolated development success does not establish reliability.
SO-101-only heads did not transfer to Panda in the tested source-frame trials; current positive heads train on both embodiments.
Frozen ACT feature conditioning did not improve success over the best no-ACT learned recovery head.
The frozen-prefix head is adapted to its actual takeover-state distribution; its native-home results differ from the earlier no-ACT head.
Different training cohorts and development-selected candidates cannot be pooled into a reliability estimate or causal attribution to one feature.
Kinematic/collision gates and lighting were retained; physical camera, joint-neutral and jaw calibration remain unverified.
